description: This file defines the class NavigationCategory, which models a navigation category within the Android Notes client for Nextcloud. It includes constructors, getters, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: NavigationCategory
classes.description: A model class representing a navigation category with a type, optional category string, and account ID.

methods.name: NavigationCategory
methods.description: Constructor for creating a NavigationCategory with a specific type. Throws IllegalArgumentException if type is DEFAULT_CATEGORY.

methods.name: NavigationCategory
methods.description: Constructor for creating a NavigationCategory with an accountId and optional category; type is set to DEFAULT_CATEGORY.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of navigation category.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the account ID associated with the category.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category string, which may be null.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare NavigationCategory objects based on type, accountId, and category.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on type, category, and accountId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NavigationCategory object.
